en.headline: Twelve students ill after free drinks with suspected pinholes at sports meet
en.dek: Police are investigating energy drinks handed out outside Hammer Hill Road Sports Ground during a school athletics meet after at least 12 pupils reported dizziness and stomach pain.
body: Police are investigating after at least 12 students reported feeling unwell after drinking free energy drinks handed out outside a school athletics meet at Hammer Hill Road Sports Ground in Wong Tai Sin on Tuesday afternoon.

Officers received a report at about 2pm that drinks had been distributed near the venue where a secondary school was holding its sports day. Some packaging was later found to have suspected pinholes. Fire services sent nine ambulances and a mobile command unit to the scene.

By about 5pm, 12 students had reported symptoms including dizziness and abdominal pain. Police recovered bottles from a bin outside the ground and are examining the drinks. The school advised students not to consume any of the free items and collected remaining bottles.
No arrests have been announced. Police said the investigation is continuing.

zh.headline: 斧山道運動場外派免費飲品疑有針孔 12學生不適
zh.dek: 黃大仙斧山道運動場外有人派發能量飲品，部分包裝懷疑有針孔，至少12名學生飲後報稱頭暈及肚痛，警方正調查。
body: 警方周二下午接報，一間中學在黃大仙斧山道運動場舉行陸運會期間，場外有人派發免費能量飲品，部分學生飲用後報稱不適，其後發現飲品包裝懷疑有針孔。
警方約下午2時接報到場調查，消防派出九輛救護車及一部流動指揮車戒備。截至下午5時左右，共有12名學生表示出現頭暈、肚痛等不適。
警方在場外垃圾桶檢走相關膠樽作調查，校方已勸喻學生勿再飲用並回收剩餘飲品。暫無人被捕，案件仍在調查中。
